briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward multi-agent AGI benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate releases amid escalating compute races and regulatory scrutiny. Prompt injection and multi-agent misalignment remain dominant risks as production deployments scale rapidly.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic Claude 4 Opus debuts advanced constitutional reasoning; xAI Grok-3 and DeepSeek-R2 close capability gaps.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins with fines issued against non-compliant agents.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell clusters reach 100k GPU scale at Microsoft; TSMC reports record AI chip demand; new Middle East sovereign AI data centers announced.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol-level security become mandatory before 2027 AGI deployments?
